sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Re: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
move.body:
Dear your company team,

You lead with our long relationship and your skilled team's dedication; it sounds like protecting that continuity matters deeply to you. We value that partnership and want a sustainable agreement that recognises justified cost changes, grounded in our recorded should-cost assessment. How can payment timing and a longer commitment help us support that continuity while keeping the price aligned with the underlying costs?

We confirm a binding volume of 4,000 units per year for 24 months. Our should-cost estimate for this part is on record (cost:part:PH-100).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 48.92 per unit, 60 days payment, 24 months, from 2026-12-01). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Thank you for your letter - it is always good to hear from you, and I answer it myself, as I do for all the customers we have known for a long time.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €51.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
Let me tell you how we see it from our side.
We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We appreciate your offer of a 24-month contract, which supports the long-term stability of our partnership and our skilled team.
Extending payment to 60 days is not possible for us, so we must retain our standard 30-day terms.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €50.90 per unit.
Please give my regards to your colleagues - a good relationship has always mattered more to us than a single order, and I hope it stays that way.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Re: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
move.body:
Dear your company team,

You welcome a longer commitment while drawing a clear line on payment timing; it sounds like stability means both lasting relationships and dependable cash flow for you. We value this partnership and want a fair, sustainable agreement grounded in the cost data you have confirmed. How can we build on that shared understanding while addressing your cash-flow concern?

We confirm a binding volume of 4,000 units per year for 24 months.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 49.23 per unit, 60 days payment, 24 months, from 2026-12-01). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Our current offer stands at a price of €50.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We value the binding volume of 4,000 units per year for 24 months, which provides stability for our skilled team. To address the cash flow concerns you kindly acknowledged, we propose meeting in the middle with a 45-day payment term. This adjustment allows us to offer a reduced price of €50.60 per unit, reflecting our commitment to this long-standing partnership. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net: €50.60 per unit. As an alternative, we can offer a price of €50.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.

Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Re: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
move.body:
Dear your company team,

You repeatedly link your price concession to faster payment; it sounds like predictable cash flow is central to making this work. We value our long-standing partnership and will honour agreed payment dates. What cost drivers should we reconcile together to establish a transparent basis for a sustainable agreement?

We confirm a binding volume of 4,000 units per year for 24 months. What is the lowest price at which you can sign these terms today?

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 49.47 per unit, 45 days payment, 24 months, from 2026-12-01). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

Please give my regards to your colleagues - a good relationship has always mattered more to us than a single order, and I hope it stays that way.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

It is always a pleasure to work with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH. Our long-standing relationship and shared roots in this region mean a great deal to our family foundry and the skilled team working here.

To bring this agreement to a close, we need you to accept our price of €50.10 for a 24-month contract with 45-day payment terms. We have reached the end of our flexibility, making this our final offer. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

For complete clarity, our offer consists of a price of €50.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This Angebot stays valid for 7 days.

We hope to continue our successful cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
